claim_one_line: THE WEIGHTED CELL AT OMEGA (sealed 434782554): given tau = omega, the Dirac masses are degenerate at omega for every weight -- the inner automorphisms (automorphy factor 1, acting as the parity signs) make every coupling diagonal in T's three parity lines at every tau, and U cycles the lines (a 3-cycle), so every U-eigenvector on the diagonal (phases 1, omega, omega^2) gives three equal masses; near omega the entries stay equal at leading order. No Majorana coupling survives at even weight (the odd-weight case not computed). So the tagged postulate tau = omega, which main recommended, cannot give the observed hierarchy within the weave; a hierarchy needs the parity sectors to separate -- the cusp. 0 of 19.
